text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a tight narrative for the latency vs price benchmark we show at the webinar. Hero should communicate 'predictable latency at lower unit cost'.
raj: Agreed. Hero chart = scatter of p50 latency (ms) on y vs cost per 1k tokens on x, color by deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private). Simple. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
elain: small typo — that's me, meant "elaine" :)
tomas: Scatter sounds good. Add a step-line showing typical SLA bands (e.g., 50ms, 200ms, 500ms) as overlays so customers can eyeball fit.
emily: For social copy we should surface one concrete takeaway: "<model X> reduces unit cost by 3x at 99th perc latencies under 250ms" — but only if eval supports it. We need a conservative claim.
elaine: Emily — good. Let's build the chart first and then craft three leadlines: 1) headline for engineers, 2) headline for platform leads (cost), 3) headline for product (UX).
raj: Data ask: can infra export per-model p50/p95/p99, tokens-per-request distribution, batching configs? If yes I can sketch viz.
deploy-bot: export job queued: perf-exports/latency_price/2901234567.csv (ETA 12m)
oliver: I'll prep a 2x2 slide: left = hero scatter + SLA bands, right-top = bar of tokens-per-request & cost, right-bottom = mini waterfall of batching impact (no-batch vs smart-batch).
tomas: For the batching mini: show two bars per model (50 vs 256) with latency and cost delta annotated. Use % delta not absolute for readability.
emily: Webinar CTA: include a short interactive demo link where users can pick model, batch size, and see estimated $/1k tokens + latencies. That'll drive signups.
elaine: Great. Responsibilities: Raj = raw charts + fig spec, Oliver = slide layout + creative hooks, Emily = copy + CTA flow, Tomas = batching micro-visual + annotation rules. I'll own final narrative and approvals.
raj: Starting with a vega-lite spec skeleton so design can wireframe quickly:
```{ "mark": "point", "encoding": {"x": {"field": "cost_per_1k", "type": "quantitative"}, "y": {"field": "p50_ms", "type": "quantitative"}, "color": {"field": "deployment_mode"}} }```
oliver: mockup ETA EOD tomorrow. Will put placeholder numbers for now.
emily: Copy draft for headline options: 
- "Serve fast, pay less: predictable low-latency inference at lower unit cost"
- "Cut token spend without sacrificing response time"
- "Price-performance that scales: latency SLAs, unit economics"
Pick one after we see the chart.
tomas: One more ask — include a tiny note explaining methodology: sample size, sequence lengths, quantization settings. Don't bury it; maybe a one-line footnote.
elaine: Yep — Raj capture metadata with the CSV export and we'll convert into a one-line methodology blurb.
raj: On it. Starting data pull now. I'll post a first draft chart as soon as the export finishes.
emily: tagging @growth for routing: once we have the hero asset, can we gate different CTAs for SMB vs Enterprise? SMB -> free trial; Enterprise -> book demo with Dedicated pricing.
elaine: Good call. Add routing rules to the assets doc.
oliver: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: perf-exports/latency_price/2901234567.csv ready (download: https://files.redwood.test/perf-exports/latency_price/2901234567.csv)
raj: downloading now. Will push first chart by +3h.
elaine: Thanks team — sync back here with the chart and 1-sentence leadlines. We'll do a quick review before sending to design. :rocket:
